name: Shardul Securities Limited
summary: Shardul Securities Ltd. functions as an investment banking entity, offering a broad spectrum of financial services. Its primary undertakings involve capital deployment in instruments such as equities and debt, participation in merchant banking, and providing funding for Initial Public Offerings (IPOs). The company further delivers financial advisory and brokerage services. Established on July 23, 1985, its main operations are based in Mumbai, India.
